script_text: The stars are about to completely rearrange your Air sign reality — and you won't see it coming. Monday through Wednesday, Neptune opposing your Virgo Sun clouds your 8th House of shared finances, creating confusion around money and loyalty. Mars in your 3rd House sharpens communication but fuels impatience. Wednesday night brings Venus into your 9th House, forming a trine with Jupiter in Gemini — opening romantic doors through travel. Thursday onward, Saturn conjunct Pluto in your 1st House — your Uranus-ruled identity zone — forces a powerful reckoning with authority. The weekend demands strategic action, not emotional reaction. Saturday is your power day — Venus trine Jupiter lights up your 9th House, opening romance through travel. Wednesday is your hardest day as Sun opposition Neptune dissolves clarity in the 8th House. Before Monday hits, document every financial commitment — Neptune's fog rewards paperwork over assumption. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
